inputs.CREATION_REQUEST: Create a production-grade network route control-plane task: a Go API that manages Linux/system route tables with a broad management surface, fleet installation and configuration through Ansible variables across multiple instances, and a frontend dashboard for network inventory and route operations.
inputs.REQUESTED_DOMAIN: Linux networking, Go control-plane API, route-table lifecycle, Ansible fleet automation, frontend network operations dashboard
inputs.NETWORK_ENVIRONMENT_CONSTRAINTS: Deterministic offline/local benchmark runtime; no dependence on cloud credentials, privileged external infrastructure, internet services, or destructive host routing. Simulate or namespace route operations safely while preserving realistic Linux routing semantics and Ansible-managed multi-node behavior.
